snippet.title: Little Planet - Official Holiday Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Little Planet is inviting everybody home for the holidays, bringing plenty of winter joy to everybody's favorite social life sim. Whether it's a hot cup of cocoa shared with friends, a visit from Santa, or the thrill of exchanging gifts after a laugh filled snowball fight, there's plenty of new fun to be had. Little Planet is free-to-play, and its holiday update is available now. Watch the Little Planet trailer for some seasonal cheer, and see what you can expect!
